Effects.Message: The puzzle has been reset!
Hey! No escaping the map!
You added Adamantite to the brew! Your inner goblin sheds a tear at that waste of rare resources.
You added Salt to the brew.
Gah, if only the wizard didn't scrap a certain evil riddle! You could've experienced the joy of solving an invisible maze.
This room seems impassable for now. A note is attached to the rubble: "This would've been the trivia quiz room, but it's too annoying to implement without the ability to nest trigger conditions."
You added Zombie Leg to the brew.
You added Stormcap Mushroom to the brew.

RejectionEffects.Message: As you pick up this bizarre potion you just made, you think back to those brambles in the hallway.
You grab a pouch of Salt from the table! Now just to get back...

Effects.Message: You made... something, alright. It smells foul, but you might as well bottle up your own creation.
Watch out for the spiky platforms!
This room hums with deadly energy... better not move when the light flashes red!
You approach a ring of lights, with a central platform in the middle. Perhaps you should step on it?

RejectionEffects.Message: You find a Burnt Zombie Arm on the table. Who just keeps these lying around?

Effects.Message: After you solve the puzzle, you suddenly get the sense that the mushrooms around you are a lot more corporeal. You should approach the shrine again.
Your concoction burns the brambles away. The dragon egg is at hand!

RejectionEffects.Message: Thick, impenetrable brambles stretch across this corridor. You are in a wizard's keep, however - she must've had some magical herbicide around. Maybe you should approach this growth with it?

Effects.Message: "Turn back," the effigy warns, "or face she who tamed the last of the dragons." You know this person to be long gone, but that won't make the cave any less treacherous.
With your exit route collapsed behind you, there's only one way left: forward, into the cave once inhabited by a mad wizard.
The wizard's lair looks utterly decrepit. Hopefully the egg is still around, though finding it won't be simple.
The door at the back is closed shut! Maybe this board ahead of you has something to do with it... (Step on the marble pedestal to reset the board.)

RejectionEffects.Message: You harvest some Adamantite! Good thing there was just some lying around...

Effects.Message: Really? You see some suspicious liquid and your first thought is to swim in it?
When you try to pick them up, all the mushroom phase through your hand. Perhaps there are some other means of gathering them.
There it is, in all its glory. It couldn't possibly be viable after all this time... but who knows?
What will become of it, I wonder? Will you keep it as a tacky artifact, sell it off, nurture it or subject it to evil shenanigans?
Whatever the case, you have it: the last dragon. Or the shelled coffin of one, depending on your perspective. Your journey is over.
(P.S. There's a small extra in this room.)
Scrawled in the margins of the only surviving page, you see "nigredo, albedo, citrinitas, rubedo." What could this mean?
You could climb to the top of the cauldron above you to put in ingredients.
Watch the sequence closely!
Repeat the pattern by jumping on top of correct blocks. Good luck.

RejectionEffects.Message: You gather a Stormcap Mushroom! This can go in the cauldron in the central room...

Made with love by Cobrinthine and Vegetal (Echoes from Beyond) & Drakon (DrakonForge Studios)
Cobrinthine: Trigger volume wizardry, initial idea, puzzle design, map construction, texturing, playtesting
Drakon: Texturing, UX, programming, puzzle design, sound design, playtesting
Vegetal: Programming, puzzle design, map construction, DevOps (yeah, for a modjam...), modelling, playtesting
We hope that you enjoyed our little map!
